name: Chez Croggy
summary: Chef Croggy, AKA Croggster, AKA Croggison, is on the trip of a lifetime! Get ready for a gruesome, and rage inducing experience as you run, jump, and push your way through the wacky physics and camera angles Chez Croggy has to offer.

name: Golf vs. Zombies
summary: Golf VS Zombies is arcade golf with an RPG twist. Tee off and slay the undead!

Le Grimoire Art Frame - Plastic art frame inspired by Justine’s Le Grimoire clipboard.

name: Chordosis
summary: Chordosis invites you to experience a unique cosmic survival sci-fi horror game centered around alien abductions. Immerse yourself in the small village of Dunahont, Hungary, and uncover its chilling mysteries.
storyline: Take on the role of Sadie, determined to find her vanished twin sister. Ignored by the authorities, Sadie embarks on a dangerous journey to unravel the truth.

name: Gold Rush Clicker
summary: Dive into "Gold Rush Clicker," an idle clicker game where you start as a novice miner. Tap to mine gold, buy upgrades, and face strategic challenges. With procedurally generated levels, stunning graphics, and Steam achievements, it's an endless journey to become the ultimate mining tycoon!

name: NASCAR Arcade Rush
summary: The NASCAR Beasts are Unleashed!

name: Bright Side: Riddles & Puzzles
summary: Who is lying? Who will survive? Which way is safe? Watch unusual stories and solve tricky riddles with your friends or solo!

name: Baby Shark: Sing & Swim Party
summary: Swim across the wide ocean with the Shark Family to enjoy the Fin-tastic Festival. Choose from five customizable characters and play either in the runner or rhythmic game mode. Sing and swim to fin-omenal songs and get rewarded with tons of musical cards to add to your album.

name: Shadow King
summary: The Shadow King has invaded the castle belonging to the Knights of Valor and they need your help to get it back! Explore the massive castle in this metroidvania and help the fallen knights back to their former glory! Upgrade your moves and weapons along the way as you fight minions, defeat bosses, find secrets, and unravel what has happened.

name: Catch Up
summary: Welcome to the enchanting world of "Catch Up"! Get ready to embark on an exciting precision platforming adventure like you've never seen before! Join an epic journey with a brave cat where skill and precision will be your best allies.
storyline:
"Catch Up" is a challenging 2D game with high-quality pixelated graphics that will transport you to three unique and stunning biomes. Explore vibrant and detailed landscapes, from lush forests to Dark Places and Ancient Ruins.
Your mission is to help our courageous feline find the way back home. However, it won't be an easy task! Face cleverly designed obstacles in every corner of the biomes. Enjoy the evolution of your movements and jumps, improving your skills throughout the journey.

The original soundtrack will immerse you even further into this captivating world. Each melody has been carefully composed to accompany your journey, creating an engaging and thrilling atmosphere.

Challenge yourself to push the platforming boundaries in "Catch Up"! Prepare for a unique gaming experience where precision and dexterity are essential for success. Master the control of our adorable feline protagonist and pave the way back home in this immersive and addictive game.

Accept the challenge and prove your skills in "Catch Up" - a game that will test your reflexes, patience, and determination, all within a charming pixelated universe.

Are you ready to help this little kitten get back home? The fate of our cat is in your hands!

name: Dungeons & Keyboards
summary: Ready your typing skills and defeat the quirky enemies of the Tower of Verbum. Collect coins, relics, and experience to buy items, assign stats and unlock permanent upgrades. How far will your typing skills take you?

name: Furry Shades of Gay 3: Still Gayer
summary: Furry Shades of Gay 3 gets even steamier and funnier with new stories, new characters and new features! Go through all the branches and see new, longer animations with more varied poses, and for the first time in the series, voice acting!
storyline: Furry Shades of Gay 3 is a collection of hot novels with choice and match-3 elements! You'll find new stories, new (and old!) characters, and a new, more diverse match-3 experience. Go through all the stories, uncover all the plot options, and unlock 15 hot voiced animations!

name: Another Crusade
summary:
The spiritual successor of a super RPG and its seven stars. A timed-battle role playing game where timing and strategy is all!

Another Crusade gathers the gameplay mechanics of Super Mario RPG. Timed-battle commands and exploration as a platformer are part of the game.

The game is currently on a kickstarter and is set to be published on Q4 2021.
storyline:
A war between humans and monsters was taking place not long ago to see which one was the ruler race. The Order of Light, founded for this same purpose, sent out groups of warriors to deal with the monsters, as this non human race is believed to hold a danger for mankind.

The war ended with the mightiest of dragons being defeated by a knight and its fellow companions.

After a week of this event, our protagonist, Rai, the knight and now dragon slayer, was about to take a well earned rest, when a meteorite came crashing just beside him. Over the horizon, barriers were being created in specific locations, one being on a town close to where Rai was.

Why are barriers appearing? Where did the meteorites come from? Are the monsters trying to reclaim the throne of the ruler race?

Rai, having his rest being crushed by a new menace, decides that it’s time to set out on an adventure again!

name: Crop Rotation
summary: Crop Rotation is a farming-theme card drafting game. Cards are played automatically so you can focus on the deck building and building synergies.

name: Dreams of a Geisha
summary: Journey through the wonderful world of Geisha. Help Ichisumi to reopen the temples and restore a world of beauty and passion.

name: The Backrooms: Last Expedition
summary: "The Backrooms: Last Expedition" is a cooperative horror game designed for 1 to 4 players. Its main objective is to create an enjoyable gaming experience for friends. Players will navigate through terrifying levels, filled with various entities and dangers, as they strive to escape.

name: Perfect Ninja Painter
summary: Perfect Ninja Painter is a colorful arcade puzzle game that's so much fun, it's hard to stop. Paint the walls through 50 levels and try to get all stars!

name: Nano Player Pro: Mega Man
summary:
Mega Man is the iconic blue bomber who has been delighting fans for over 30 years. Mega Man is one of the most popular video game franchises of all time. The Mega Man series has sold over 38 million units worldwide. With his ability to absorb the powers of his enemies, Mega Man is a force to be reckoned with. Battle your way through challenging levels, defeat powerful bosses, and save the world from Dr. Wily's evil plans.

Includes Mega Man, Mega Man 2, Mega Man 3, Mega Man 4, Mega Man 5 and Mega Man 6.

name: Dashbounce
summary: Dashbounce is a 2D Speedrunning Puzzle-Platformer about going fast and intentionally abusing physics quirks! Seek the goal in each level before the clock hits zero - but watch out, you can't jump! You'll have to use your surprising speed and bouncy body to turn every object and obstacle into an advantage!

name: Golf vs. Zombies
summary: Golf VS Zombies is an arcade golf simulator with RPG elements which combines golfing precision with action-packed combat against the undead. Grab your clubs and get in your golf cart, for in this zombie apocalypse, there is only golf.
storyline: Frenemies. We mean frenemies. There are no friends in the post-apocalyptic, living dead-infested wasteland. So you might want to take your club, hit those courses, collect bottlecaps (what other currency did you expect? rupees?), and drive your golf cart through crowds of zombies for fun and profit. OR! Or you can invite up to 3 more people to a hilarious hot-seat golfing duel, treuel, or even quadruel, where survival is optional, but fun is unavoidable.

name: Super Brawl Rush
summary: Super Brawl Rush is a boss rush beat'em up set in the scorched post-apocalyptic lands of the near future. Choose your champion and fight your way between swarms of bloodthirsty thugs, mutants and cultists.

name: For a Vast Future: Deluxe Edition
summary:
Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to stop Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

name: Grey Area
summary: A tough platformer following an 8-year-old diving over, under, and around the terrifying creatures living in a strange, mysterious world that's so much bigger than her: the "world between all worlds".

name: Charles Haunted Mansion
summary: Charles Haunted Mansion is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a mansion, haunted by the vengeful spirit of a woman who was murdered inside the mansion decades ago.

name: Pep-Pel
summary: Run through each level as Pep-Pel! a goofy red goblin thing. In this beautifully hand drawn game. play through tons of fast-paced and difficult levels, each with there own challenge to master!

name: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Menorca
summary: The popular holiday island Menorca is now also available for X-Plane. The current aerial images come in a resolution of 50cm/pixel down to 25cm/pixel in the airport area.

name: Lies of P: Deluxe Edition
Dead Matter
summary:
A rogue-lite that aims to quench the community’s thirst for a title that properly balances survival mechanics with fulfilling gameplay.

Dead Matter is a true sandbox survival horror. Players will fight to survive in a zombie-packed, post-apocalyptic world that fosters whichever play-style fits you best. Settle down and defend your home from outside threats with an expansive crafting and barricading system, cultivate and live off the land, or branch out, explore, and scavenge whatever vehicles, weapons, and food you may find in a zombie-plagued Alberta – alone, or with your friends.

name: Blood Strike
summary: Charge into fast paced combat in modes such as Battle Royale, Squad Fight or Hot Zone alone or with friends. Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between. Customize your weapons to your liking and get ready to prove that you have what it takes to come out on top!

name: Webventure
summary: You and your friend will have work together to overcome challenges using your webs and creativity, helping each other and unraveling the mysteries of the forest.

summary: Play as an existing or fully customized political figure, and campaign for the Spanish general election of 2023! In "Vox Populi: Spain 2023", you and the characters around you will have to promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

Marcella Moon: Killer at the Cove

summary: Patience and timing are key Bounce Trials, where you are a perptually bouncing ball that bounces through levels to reach a goal. Your only influence over the ball is to move either left or right. Compete against the clock and earn Gold, Silver, and Bronze rewards based on your completion time.

name: Bancroft Academy
summary: "Bancroft Academy" plunges you into the vibrant and unpredictable world of college life, with an enchanting twist. In this adult visual novel, every choice you make shapes the narrative, leading you down thrilling paths of romance, mystery, and magic.

summary: Join Scarlet, the last remaining Maiden of the Sacred Flame, in her sinful quest to defeat the Prime Evil. Explore the randomly generated dungeons of the Underworld, learn new abilities, equip Scarlet with powerful equipment, and engage in lewd activities along the way.

name: The Princess's Dragon
summary: Traverse the winding dungeon of the dragon as you attempt to reverse the curse that has been set upon you by the cursed sword.

summary: Mage Lords of Brams is a "bullet heaven"/"reverse bullet hell" roguelite. Slaughter countless fantasy enemies with your powerful spells, powers and artifacts while gathering research scrolls to improve future runs inbetween levels. Thousands of race/class/item combinations allow for endless variety.

name: Maid Slaves & Golden Dungeon
summary: A dungeon exploration RPG. Living a pure love life with a captured general. Go to the dungeon to earn money with the former general who now is my maid!

summary: 'Octopus Island' is a leisure type game with the theme of ocean elements. The game simulates a pinball machine. The player controls the left and right baffles to hit the marbles out, so as not to let the marbles fall into the middle hole.

summary: Train your brain with this awesome puzzle bundle!

summary: This is an indie 2D hand-drawn platformer game which takes place in fantasy environment set in Czechia. You will embody a creature consumed by hatred and get revenge on your enemies in this short game.

summary: P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L. It is a multiplayer TPS game with fantastic and colorful graphics, developed by a small team. Fight across multiple game modes and ever-growing maps. Take to the Field, Fight and Survive!

name: No Sun To Worship
summary: Sneak into enemy bases, rescue hostages, hack computers and play your own way while you uncover a conspiracy to unearth unspeakable horrors. Stick to the shadows and stop an ancient curse in this mission-based stealth adventure!

name: Redline Racing
summary: High Pace, High Skill Time-trial Racing Game

name: Symmodance
summary: Dive into the symphonic chaos of geometric warfare! Unleash futuristic weaponry, customize your hovering platform, conquer relentless foes and dance to victory in this mesmerizing reverse bullet hell shooter.

name: Adventure Apple Robots
summary: Help the hero to find out why his brother is always running away, explore this fantastic world and unlock new skills as he ventures.

name: Rogue Card
summary: Rogue Card is a roguelike deck builder, where every run is unique and strategy matters. Set in a randomized fantasy world, where tactical decisions affect the outcome of your whole game.

name: Clanswoman
summary: It is a story about the adventure of two sisters who leave their quiet lives behind and embark on a journey of revenge due to some unfortunate events. Turn based adventure game.

name: Silent Seeker
summary: Silent Seeker is a "Hide & Seek" multiplayer game. Play in the clutches of the hunter to find the props hidden in the map! Or Play as a prop and hide from the hunter!

name: Elon vs AI
summary: Elon vs AI is a 3D arena shooter in which you have to play as a warrior on a large arena, shooting persistent robots, gaining experience, improving skills, buying new weapons and fighting different types of robots.

name: Sniper Hunter Shooter
summary: For game lovers seeking realism, Sniper Hunter Shooter is an experience not to be missed! Fight as a sniper in a post-apocalyptic world, create your strategy, and test your shooting skills.

name: Inhibit
summary: "Inhibit" is an exhilarating and highly challenging speed run platform game that will put your reflexes to the ultimate test. Each level is more demanding than the previous one, and the slightest mistake will determine the difference between victory and defeat.

name: Pixel Puzzles World War II Jigsaws: Pack - Battle of Peleliu
summary: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

name: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones
summary: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones is a fighting game featuring digitized stereotyped character trying to win the presidency of Mexico.

name: Laruaville 5
summary: Use your Match 3 skills to build a ship and help ghosts leave an uninhabited island!

name: HexaWars
summary: Retro twin stick shooter that gradually gets more difficult as you defeat more waves of enemies and Bosses.

name: NASCAR Arcade Rush: Project-X Edition
summary: NASCAR Arcade Rush Project-X Edition is the ultimate NASCAR arcade experience for fans young and old by combining the full game with the thrill of all the Project-X digital content available.

name: Alder Forge
summary: Play as the Five Members of the Fourth Squadron and battle your foes using the game Adaptive Turn-Based Combat System, shape your own path in a story-driven game with a handcrafted world and unique characters.

name: Mow VR: Challenge Your Limits
summary: Mow VR is a wave-based simple shooting game. This is designed to be easily enjoyed by new VR users and light gamers. No need to reload, just keep on defeating the oncoming enemies. It's so exhilarating. Defeat the enemies, earn stars, unlock weapons, and challenge your limits!

name: For a Vast Future: Colour Palette 2
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Anniversary Edition
summary:
This edition includes:
- Sprite Sticker Sheet
- Art Booklet
- Pizza Hut Personal Pan Pizza Coupon
- Dimension Shellshock DLC
storyline: With Bebop and Rocksteady amassing gizmos to support Krang and Shredder’s latest scheme, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge finds the turtles battling through a breathless tour of iconic TMNT locations to thwart their nemeses’ most diabolical plan yet. Armed with shell-shocking new abilities built on a foundation of classic brawling mechanics, the gang are in for an exhilarating, Foot Clan-stomping romp leading them through the sewers and bustling boroughs of New York City all the way to Dimension X.

name: Sunbeam
summary: A garden-themed 2D RPG which tackles the struggle of problem-solving in an uncomfortable and unknown place. Solve and explore your way across this dark landscape to uncover the truth behind your visit, meeting a familiar face to keep you compay.

name: Click For Cash: Cashed Out
summary:
it's time to click till you're filthy rich... again!

Welcome to Click For Cash: Cashed Out, the best idle clicker game about yellow buttons since the original Click For Cash! This sequel is filled to the brim with new features, customization, and polish. In this game you click a button for cash (real original, I know), purchase a variety of upgrades to get more money, and unlock achievements to become the richest person in the universe! at least in the game...

name: Ratchet & Clank: Premature Release
summary: A vertical slice of an unofficial and unfinished PS2 era-styled Ratchet and Clank fangame that will likely never reach completion.
storyline: Ratchet and Clank are hired to investigate a water farm on Pokitaru.

name: Car Parking Simulator 2024
summary: Get ready to test your precision and skill behind the wheel in the most immersive parking simulator yet - Car Parking Simulator 2024! Dive into a world where every inch matters, and every corner poses a new challenge.

name: Japanese Rural Life Adventure
summary: Experience countryside living in Japanese Rural Life Adventure. "View the cherry blossoms in the spring, attend the festival in the summer, eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall, hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year."

name: Simple Snooker
summary: This is a two-player Snooker game, that runs on computer desktop or virtual reality device.

name: Posthaste
summary: An arcade rally game.

name: Hentai Girls: Premium Edition
summary: In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Yui and Etsuko - two of the girls from the main game.

name: Paranormal VHS
summary: Paranormal VHS is a horror game that features a VHS tape-inspired aesthetic. The game's story revolves around a popular vlogger who spends a night in haunted locations in search of paranormal activity.
storyline:
James is a vlogger of the channel Paranormal VHS, where he spends a night in some horrifying and abandoned locations where terrible events have happened. His equipment is just a VHS camera that allows him to record any paranormal activity.

His next vlog is to spend a night in the Crimson Hill Hospital that were rumours horrifying experiments were made on their patients and due to some recent mysterious events, the building is now abandoned and considered haunted.

name: Project: Artificial Legacy Saga
summary: Embark on journey through the "Project: Artificial Legacy Saga" a four-part series, crafted to feel as if it was released across four console generations. Follow Kirana on her heroic journey, as she protects her family and her homeland from a mysterious evil force.
storyline:
1000 years ago, humans were severed from their connection to the world's magic. Today Dr. Asher has created a device that will once again allow humans to re-tap into it. Code-named Project: Artificial Legacy, the device will allow its user access to different powers when combined with one of four crystals. But Evil forces from an unknown land have found out about the doctor's discovery and have kidnapped him. It’s now up to his young daughter Kirana to use his prototype device and fight her way through an underground labyrinth to rescued him.

Jump, Push objects out of your way, stop lavafalls, and create blocks out of thin air, all while avoiding dangerous creatures as you travel deep underground searching for the 4 keys that will unlock your path to rescue your father. Along the way find the 3 missing crystals to unlock the full potential of the device and send them back enemies back to the world they came from, In this NES style action game.

name: New Super Mario World 1: The Twelve Magic Orbs - Powered-Up
summary: A remake of New Super Mario World 1: The Twelve Magic Orbs which aims to polish the original hack by improving the level design and giving more replay value.
storyline: Bowser has stolen the 12 magic orbs from Peach's castle! Mario must put his courage to test and face all sorts of minions in his way. Collect coins and power-ups and save the Mushroom Kingdom!

name: The Backrooms: Survival
summary: The Backrooms: Survival mixes survival horror with roguelike elements. Explore randomly generated levels with different items and entities while trying to maintain your thirst, hunger, and sanity.

name: Quantum Tripper: Math
summary:
Purchasing this DLC enables the Math map to be fully playable.
When computational advancements render human sapience obsolete.

name: Princess Bubble Story
summary: Bubble puzzler full of magic!

name: Boti: Byteland Overclocked
summary: Jump, Dash, Collect! Play solo and with your friends and loved ones! Explore this cute 3D platformer where you play as Boti, a brave and adorable data bot. Join Boti on an adventure to save the cyber-world of Byteland from bugs and viruses!
storyline: Dive into Byteland as Boti, a brave and adorable data bot that sets out to save the cyber-landscape from bugs and viruses! Explore the secrets of this robot-run world together with your two floating companions, One & Zero. You can even invite a friend or family member for some co-op fun!
